藏品名称_EN: Three mirrors of three gods and three beasts with triangular rim and divine beast motif
藏品名称_ZN: 赤塚古墳 三角縁獣文帯三神三獣鏡
描述_EN: Akatsuka Tomb, located on a plateau in Takamori, Usa City, Oita Prefecture, is a 57.5-meter-long front concave round tomb, excavated in 1921. Five triangular-sided animal and plant mirrors, a pipe ball, and a fragment of an iron sword were found in a box-shaped sarcophagus in the center of the back circle, which was in an upright position. These triangular-edged animal and zoological mirrors were made in China, making it one of the oldest tombs in Kyushu, dating back to the first half of the 4th century. The same mirrors have been found in the Ishitsuyama Tomb in Fukuoka Prefecture, the Tsubaki-Otsuyama Tomb in Kyoto Prefecture, and the Tsuno Tomb in Mie Prefecture, and their relationship is drawing attention.
描述_ZN: 赤冢墓位于大分县宇佐市高森的高原上，是一座长57.5米的前凹式圆坟，于1921年发掘。在后圆中央的箱形石棺中，发现了5个三角边的动植物镜、一个管球和一把铁剑碎片，该石棺呈直立状态。 这些三角边的动物和动物镜子都是在中国制造的，这使得它成为九州最古老的墓穴之一，可以追溯到4世纪上半叶。 同样的镜子也在福冈县的石津山古墓、京都府的椿大津山古墓和三重县的堤野古墓中被发现，它们之间的关系正在引起人们的注意。
